obligations.blocked_transition: publish or consume a law under a competing contract identity
obligations.recovery: restore the one promise-machine/v1 contract identity and rerun the obligation check

obligations.blocked_transition: accept a governed promise declaration with an incomplete field contract
obligations.recovery: restore every required declaration field and rerun the obligation check

obligations.blocked_transition: publish generated installation copies without the canonical-source identity
obligations.recovery: restore the canonical generated-copy marker, regenerate copies, and rerun the obligation check

obligations.blocked_transition: authorise a transition under a weakened governing principle
obligations.recovery: restore the settled governing principle and rerun the obligation check

obligations.blocked_transition: accept a root law with a missing or duplicated normative section
obligations.recovery: restore every required heading exactly once and rerun the obligation check
